verdict.rationale: Docs confirm one-click/few-taps forwarding requests to any address (docs-6, docs-22, docs-18) and forwarding to domestic/international addresses (docs-2), but there is no mention of saved recipient lists, carrier choice, or cost shown before confirming a forward — these details are absent from all evidence. missing for 10: saved recipients feature, carrier selection options, upfront cost/price display before confirming forward.
